**Source presence is not Production status.** The Master Book names a smaller known polished production set. This catalogue deliberately preserves the distinction. See [production and implementation status](../production-status.qmd).

### Coverage in this snapshot

- **66** discoverable module objects
- **276** module-owned capability/method IDs indexed from registry/RIL/method/screen evidence
- **147** module-owned XLSForms
- **218** module-local Markdown documents

The [method index](../methods.qmd) is better when you already know a canonical method ID.
